↳ Posted by swisspiper on October 19th, 2018.

Re: Muñeira D’Antón

This is indeed a traditional Asturian tune, from the county of Degaña. Folk in Asturias learnt it from a piper and flute player called Antón de Fonduveigas, that’s probably where the name comes from.

↳ Posted by DaveF on March 4th, 2022.
